Application Data.NAME: Green Golf Pro Shop
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: The Green Golf Pro Shop specializes in retail sales of golf and sporting equipment, offering a wide array of products including golf clubs, balls, apparel, and related accessories. We maintain a secure and well-organized store environment, equipped with a professionally monitored alarm system and robust loss prevention measures such as surveillance cameras and secure display cases. With a strong focus on customer safety, we ensure our premises are well-maintained and adherent to safety protocols to minimize slip-and-fall liabilities. Additionally, we do not engage in equipment rentals or the sale of firearms, aligning our operations with preferred underwriting guidelines. Our business has demonstrated financial stability with a positive cash flow and a solid credit history.
